Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using LiterLlm;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
using var client = LiterLlmConverter.CreateClientFromJson("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"opendal:memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}");
var result = await client.ChatAsync(new ChatCompletionRequest { Messages = new List<Message>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Message>("{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, Model = "openai/gpt-4o" });
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
